text:
DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSES OF CHRONIC LYMPHOCYTIC LEUKAEMIA
Differential Diagnoses
- Low grade non-Hodgkin's lymphomas with frequent blood and bone
marrow involvement (leukaemia / lymphoma syndromes)
- Tuberculosis
- Viral infections
- Toxoplasmosis
